notes: Inbound lead from YC-alum founders. Early-stage fintech focusing on BNPL and transaction insights. Currently on AWS, PostgreSQL + event pipeline (Kafka). Wants hosted API to move fast, expects to keep PII out of prompts but wants audit logs + KMS for key management. SOC2 (in progress) and SSO/SAML are gating items for larger pilot customers — they said: 'we need SOC2 Type II evidence before we sign larger commitments'. VPC curiosity: CTO asked about dedicated VPC/private deployment later, but first priority is fast POC on hosted. Cost sensitivity: estimates important — asked for guidelines on batching/embedding dims to reduce cost. Primary workloads: embeddings for semantic search across transactions and documents, chat-based customer support assistant (internal first), reranking for fraud signals. Latency targets: embeddings <100ms median for single-vector queries; chat responses within 200-500ms token generation (prefer low latency). Model preference: open models ok (LLama variants), but wants Redwood recommendations + quantization profiles. POC plan request: provide SE checklist (QPS, sample dataset, prompt set), perf test harness, expected token usage and cost projection. Quotes: CTO "if hosted performance looks good we'll expand — but SOC2 & SSO are checklist items for procurement". Attachments: pricing deck link and security FAQ asked (Drive link provided).
sales_pitch_notes: Position hosted API as fastest path to validate workload and cost. Highlight SOC2 artefacts, SSO options, KMS integrations, and short-term roadmap for VPC/dedicated.
